reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual fourth-round review of external-04 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-04 retains the restored dark eyebrows beneath the visor and now has exactly two upper note rows with exactly two compact gray-mark groups per row, no third row and largely blank lower paper. The olive cap with gold front/visor decoration, covered hair, one restrained closed mouth, smooth chin and absence of added glasses or facial hair remain. The near-frontal slightly viewer-left pose, red/gold collar patches, gold shoulder trim and small central collar/ribbon area remain. The rounded lower head meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque muted gray-olive backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Very fine upper-lip hair/eyewear, tiny cap/collar symbols and the small central ribbon/pendant construction are not fully legible at source scale. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the restored eyebrows and exact two-by-two note layout are directly visible.
